hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Central Africa, east of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, west of Tanzania || hilly and mountainous, dropping to a plateau in east, some plains || landlocked; straddles crest of the Nile-Congo watershed; the Kagera, which drains into Lake Victoria, is the most remote headstream of the White Nile || Resources: nickel, uranium, rare earth oxides, peat, cobalt, copper, platinum, vanadium, arable land, hydropower, niobium, tantalum, gold, tin, tungsten, kaolin, limestone || Exports: gold, coffee, tea, tin ores, iron bars (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: hilly and mountainous, dropping to a plateau in east, some plains || Central Africa, east of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, west of Tanzania

climate.excerpt: equatorial; high plateau with considerable altitude variation (772 m to 2,670 m above sea level); average annual temperature varies with altitude from 23 to 17 degrees Celsius but is generally moderate; average annual rainfall is about 150 cm with two wet seasons (February to May and September to November) and two dry seasons (June to August and December to January) || flooding; landslides; drought

economy.excerpt: highly agrarian, low-income Sub-Saharan economy; declining foreign assistance; increasing fiscal insolvencies; dense and still growing population; COVID-19 weakened economic recovery and flipped two years of deflation || Exports: gold, coffee, tea, tin ores, iron bars (2023) || Industries: light consumer goods (sugar, shoes, soap, beer); cement, assembly of imported components; public works construction; food processing (fruits)
